goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse-Labs/.github single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a correctly owned replaceable always-on carrier whose writable SHWP state is reconstructable from pertinent Master Records and survives carrier restart/replacement without transferring heartbeat scheduling authority to any carrier provider.
success_predicates: A provider-independent continuous carrier runs the canonical runtime
All startup/restart state is reconstructable from pertinent Master Records and canonical repository records
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt and canonical-checkpoint state survive carrier restart/replacement
Runtime v8 owns internal heartbeat cadence and worker activation
Restart/replacement continuity preserves or increments the one heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No ChatGPT automation, GitHub schedule, Render cron or equivalent external scheduler owns worker activation
failure_predicates: Any named hosting provider is treated as a required dependency
A stateless or sleeping carrier is presented as durable always-on activation without reconstructable state
A third-party scheduler becomes the normative heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Carrier restart/replacement loses or forks canonical heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt or checkpoint state

task.derivation_reason: Protocol is complete. Production activation requires a continuously executing replaceable carrier reconstructed from Master Records; no single provider is a dependency.

activation.recheck_trigger: a provider-independent continuously executing carrier can reconstruct canonical SHWP state from Master Records and start scripts/run_heartbeat_runtime.py --continuous

completion.next_authorized_action: Start the canonical runtime continuously on any admissible replaceable carrier using Master Records reconstruction, then prove heartbeat advancement and restart/replacement continuity without introducing provider dependency.
terminal_when: A continuously executing canonical heartbeat carrier is active
Master Records reconstruction restores the canonical state after restart/replacement
StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 activation predicates are all satisfied
